[Root.GetName]在小行星表面的坑洞中发现了令人不安的隐藏科技。

显然有人——用简单粗略的方法——在此处稳定创造了一个单向虫洞。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]得出结论，这颗小行星是一个出口。虫洞的另一端是一块距离某个黑洞几光年远的未知区域，并有少量暗物质——因为受到虹吸——从虫洞中泄漏。

不管是谁建立虫洞，他们似乎已经放弃了此项行动。

texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] finds a disturbing tangle of technology hidden in a deep crater on the asteroid's surface.

Evidently someone has - by rather simplistic means - managed to stabilize a one-way wormhole. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests that the asteroid is an exit point. The other end opens up somewhere in uncharted space some light-years away from a black hole, and small quantities of dark matter are leaking - being siphoned - through the wormhole.

Whoever set this up seems to have abandoned the operation.
